requirements.title: Canvas modes and reference resolution
requirements.implementation: Overlay HUD; world-space zombie bar; 1920x1080 scale with screen size, match 0.5

requirements.title: Zombie prefab health bar
requirements.implementation: 100x12 at y=1.4 with scale .01; red fill, no handle, no input, no world raycaster

requirements.title: Health display on change
requirements.implementation: Private zombie health; read-only properties; one root controller writes Slider only when health or capacity changes

requirements.title: Canvas billboard
requirements.implementation: LateUpdate rotates only HealthBarCanvas to cached camera forward

requirements.title: Player HUD layout
requirements.implementation: 640x140 bottom-left group; 600x80 health at (20,45), 600x50 stamina at (20,12); required colors

requirements.title: Player health
requirements.implementation: Awake initializes 100; IDamageable reduces health and clamps at zero; dead player ignores more damage

requirements.title: Zombie attack
requirements.implementation: TryGetComponent<IDamageable>; damage 10 each 1.2 seconds inside range with hit point and normal

requirements.title: Stamina model
requirements.implementation: MaxStamina=100 and public getter; both Shift keys, jump costs and non-consumption-frame recovery

requirements.title: HUD data binding
requirements.implementation: All references stored; display-only normalized values; no notifications and only writes on changes

requirements.title: Damage flash
requirements.implementation: Fullscreen red Image, alpha 0.4 fading to zero over 0.3 seconds; coroutine restarts on repeated hit; Player linked

checks: Scene and prefab YAML parse; unique file IDs; no dangling local references; reciprocal component and transform ownership
Exactly one HUD controller and prefab zombie bar; Player, PlayerMove, Sliders, flash and canvas explicitly linked
10.1 / 10.5: overlay scaling and exact bottom-left HUD sizes, positions, red/yellow fills, zero horizontal gaps
All three Sliders have assigned Fill Rect, normalized range, left-to-right fill and no input, handle or transition
10.2 / 10.3 / 10.4: world bar at height 1.4, size 100x12, scale .01, no raycaster; zombie stats 30/10/1.2
10.6: full-screen transparent red flash, first canvas child, nonblocking, configured .4 alpha and .3-second fade
Only eight chapter-related existing assets changed; original GUIDs/metas, world geometry, camera, crosshair, gun/bomb/pool and zombie placement preserved

cases: Player initializes in Awake, loses health, clamps at zero, ignores damage after death
Zombie attacks for 10 every 1.2 seconds in range; leaving range prevents damage
IDamageable dispatch sends damage, point and normal; missing targets/components are guarded
Zombie health 30 to 20 to 10 to zero; missing blood effect guarded; death ignores more damage
Both Shift keys consume sprint stamina; jump costs 20; rest recovers 15/s; capacity and affordability respected
HUD displays current ratios, detects max-health changes, guards zero max and skips 10000 unchanged-frame writes
HUD missing serialized references disable the component with a diagnostic
World health bar displays damage, caches unchanged values, resolves child references and billboards canvas without rotating zombie
Hit flash starts at 0.4, fades over 0.3 seconds and restarts a single coroutine on repeated damage
Disable and zero-duration paths clean up; Player.TakeDamage invokes the linked flash
csharp_behavior_validation.mode: Actual six changed scripts compiled and executed against test-only Unity API stubs; no Unity Editor

compiler.name: Roslyn
compiler.input: Six changed gameplay scripts plus original DamageInfo and IDamageable; test-only Unity API model
compiler.warnings: CS0649 on Inspector-assigned fields; their scene/prefab references were checked separately

package_scope: Eight existing assets updated with original GUIDs; documentation and original eight-file rollback package included
native_acceptance_checks: Import all into the original project with Play mode off; reopen GameScene after compilation.
Play: Shift and Jump lower the yellow bar; resting restores it.
Stand near zombie: health falls by 10 every 1.2s, with the 0.3s red flash behind HUD.
Shoot zombie: health bar falls in 10/30 steps and stays facing the camera while the zombie turns.
not_added: Optional comeback-heal behavior from prior chapter
limitations: API-model behavior tests do not validate Unity Editor import, real rendering, input configuration beyond direct Shift keys, physics, or frame timing.
